homeConfig.content:
[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/artifacts-acme-test/"

[registry]
global-credential-providers = ["cargo:token"]

[source.spindrift-upstream-internal]
registry = "sparse+https://artifacts.acme.test/api/cargo/internal/index/"
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy-artifacts-acme-test-internal"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy-artifacts-acme-test-internal]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/artifacts-acme-test/api/cargo/internal/index/"

[registries.spindrift-registry-proxy-artifacts-acme-test-internal]
index = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/artifacts-acme-test/api/cargo/internal/index/"

[source.remote]
registry = "sparse+https://artifacts.acme.test/api/cargo/remote/index/"
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy-artifacts-acme-test-remote"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy-artifacts-acme-test-remote]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/artifacts-acme-test/api/cargo/remote/index/"

[registries.spindrift-registry-proxy-artifacts-acme-test-remote]
index = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/artifacts-acme-test/api/cargo/remote/index/"
